investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (250) was observed from the user, significantly above the 24-hour baseline of 30 files. The activity targets the SharePoint site https://globalcorp.sharepoint.com/sites/Arhitektuur_Projektid/ and originates from ARC-DESK-012, with a cross-border geolocation listed as Tokyo, Japan. The combination of a large data volume, cross-border location, and multiple project files raises concern for potential data exfiltration and warrants HP and further investigation.
